subject: Agriculture
title: Regenerative Agriculture
description: A quick win: understand Regenerative Agriculture.

hook.text: Regenerative agriculture doesn't just sustain soil—it aims to rebuild it. The goal is improvement, not maintenance.

buildup.text: Core practices: no-till, cover crops, diverse rotations, integrated livestock, and minimum synthetic inputs.

discovery.text: Healthy soil sequesters carbon from the atmosphere—potentially offsetting some agricultural emissions.

twist.text: There's no legal definition of 'regenerative.' Anyone can claim it. Standards are still being developed.

climax.text: Major food companies are investing billions in regenerative supply chains—it's the fastest-growing movement in agriculture.

punchline.text: Farm to improve the soil, not just use it. That's the shift.

quiz.question: How does regenerative agriculture differ from sustainable agriculture?
options: It aims to actively rebuild soil rather than just maintain it
